name: PROJECT R.E.D.
description: Since 1975, Japan’s iconic Super Sentai series has defined the tokusatsu landscape. Now, after 50 years, Japan’s weekly tokusatsu broadcasting timeslot will welcome a brand-new project by Toei titled, PROJECT R.E.D. (short for Records of Extraordinary Dimensions). PROJECT R.E.D. is a new tokusatsu series featuring a red hero in action.

videos.title: Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity: Jo-Chaku Course
videos.overview:
Use the Gavarion Trigger to Jo-Chaku! You too can master "Jo-Chaku"! Be sure to check out Gavan Infinity's battle too!

The Jo-Chaku Course takes place after Ep. 2: Twin Blades, as the Archives Division recall deploying Cosmo Gavarion GC-R, which was first used on-screen in that episode.

videos.title: Red Gavan
videos.overview:
Reiji Doki, an investigator for the Galaxy Federal Police, is Gavan Infinity—the sole individual in the cosmos authorized to bear the title "Space Sheriff Gavan." Yet he languishes in the marginal Archives Division, enduring daily ridicule from detectives in the First Investigative Division.

Few know his true purpose: investigating trans-dimensional Emorgear crimes.

Reiji now heads for "MultiEarth Λ8018," where an Emorgy Negative Wave threatens to expand across dimensions and potentially collapse the entire universe. Amidst Λ8018's chaos, he encounters Setsuna Aikokuin, captain of the Galaxy Federal Police's Special Forces, but...!

videos.title: Twin Blades
videos.overview:
Setsuna, known as Gavan Bushido, the Space Sheriff Gavan of MultiEarth Λ8018, confronts Reiji, who has fused with Gavan—a being that shouldn't exist in two forms...

To silence the arrested Hitoshi Kuzumi, the crime syndicate's boss, Karasumaro, attacks Setsuna and his team. As one incident follows another, Setsuna sees Reiji burning with rage toward Karasumaro and...!

videos.title: Kiki and Koto
videos.overview:
Reiji, pursuing a new Emorgear negative wave, heads to MultiEarth Ι5109. There, he begins investigating an Emorgear incident where humans turn into bubbles, alongside the duo of Kiki Iwai and Kotobuki Takanari from the Galaxy Federal Police's Forensics Division.

As the trio sought the truth behind the incidents, a new Emons attacked them, and Kiki transforms into Gavan Luminous!

videos.title: Underground Fortress
videos.overview:
On MultiEarth Σ3302, a series of bizarre incidents occur where vital facilities vanish one after another! Reiji, dispatched to the scene, encounters the Galaxy Federal Police investigative duo: Mikuro Arimoto and Shoko Hanemura. Though shocked by Arimoto's seemingly impossible existence, Reiji begins investigating alongside them.

Soon, Reiji and his team arrive at a mysterious underground fortress, only to be attacked by the culprit's drill machine and find themselves in a pinch...!

videos.title: Sword and Bullet
videos.overview:
Setsuna and Peacekeeping Corps Chief Rui Amou were racing to arrest the smugglers conducting clandestine deals on MultiEarth Λ8018. Amidst this, Amou was abducted by an unknown assailant. Though every moment counted, Headquarters orders Setsuna to stand by...

Conflicted, Setsuna reunites with Reiji, who has crossed dimensions, and is entrusted with something. As the two fight together once more, the secret behind Setsuna's dual-wielding style is revealed...!?

videos.title: Phantom Thief Fade Enters
videos.overview:
While out shopping on MultiEarth I5109, Kiki and Kotobuki encounter Fuware and Emu, a mother and daughter on the run. Just then, the phantom thief Fade, who is pursuing them, appears, and Kotobuki fights fiercely to protect the two.

In the midst of the chaos, an Emorgear goes haywire, putting Emu in grave danger! With Reiji crossing dimensions to lend a hand, will Kiki and Koto be able to save Emu...!?

videos.title: Black Gavan
videos.overview:
An incident occurs on MultiEarth A0073. Not only the First Investigation Division, but also Reiji and Colonel Date from the Archives Division rush to the scene. Suddenly, a black Gavan appears, and the colonel is injured. Reiji sees the figure of his former senior, Taito Gato, superimposed on the colonel...!?

Reiji, who has been harboring anger for quite some time, fights Death Gavan even as he is battered and bruised...!

videos.title: The Shooter with Magic Bullets
videos.overview:
A series of mysterious runaway incidents has occurred on MultiEarth ∧8018. The runaways appear to be caused by long-range sniping by a Nega Emorgy. Setsuna, recalling a man who once served as a sniper during an interstellar war long ago, begins an investigation alongside Reiji and AGI, who have rushed across dimensions to join him.

As the investigation progresses, an Emons attacks and Setsuna transforms, but the sniper’s bullet targets Gavan Bushido…!!

videos.title: Crisis in the Forensics Division
videos.overview: In order to have the words of the previously missing Emorgear Yukaida analyzed, Reiji heads to the Galaxy Federal Police Forensic Division on MultiEarth Ι5109. There, Kiki and Kotobuki are in the middle of a huge fight for some reason. Just then, a new species of Emons that multiplies infinitely appears, putting Earth Ι5109 in danger of destruction!? Even in the midst of this emergency, Kiki and Kotobuki continue to fight, and to their surprise, even the Phantom Thief Fade shows up...

videos.title: Ninja Gavan
videos.overview: On MultiEarth A0073, Reiji and his team head out to inspect the Cosmo Gavarion’s new enhancement unit. Just as they marvel at the dragon-themed unit, Space Sheriff Gavan Raiya—Kunai Kazanami—suddenly appears, dressed like a ninja, and attacks them. If he came from another dimension, does that mean Kunai is a dimension-hopper like Reiji...!? Reiji transforms into Gavan Infinity and clashes fiercely with Gavan Raiya...!

videos.title: Dimensional Ninja Scroll
videos.overview: After escaping from the interrogation room on MultiEarth A0073, Kunai takes Reiji with him and crosses dimensions to MultiEarth Z2066. Waiting for them there was the Galactic Syndicate Bai Akube, the greatest enemy of the Galaxy Federal Police. In exchange for bringing Reiji with him, Kunai had made “a certain promise” to the leader, Rurugie…!? Soon, Kunai and Reiji engage in a massive brawl within Bai Akube’s impregnable giant fortress. Kunai’s heart is shaken by Reiji’s fearless fighting style…

videos.title: Samurai and Ninja
videos.overview: During a conversation with Reiji and the others, Setsuna begins to wonder if he, as an android, might actually have emotions. “If that’s the case…” he thinks, and tries various methods to see if he can perform the act of crying—something he has secretly longed to do—but since he lacks the structural “tear-shedding function,” he fails every single time. "In that case..." Setsuna heads to the "Gathering of Those Who Long for Tears," where he finds Kunai, who has crossed dimensions to meet the other Gavan. Finally, the samurai and ninja Gavan come face to face, but...!?

videos.title: The Gavan Kidnapping Case
videos.overview:
Kiki has been kidnapped by someone!? Relying on the Kanky Emorgear left behind at the scene of her disappearance, Kotobuki begins the search. Kunai, who has crossed dimensions to arrive on MultiEarth I5109, also joins the investigation.

Just then, another emergency arises. To save Kiki, who is acting strangely—unlike her usual self—Kunai transforms into Gavan Raiya and unleashes a surprising new ninja technique!

videos.title: The Truth of the Universe
videos.overview:
Death Gavan suddenly reappears, and Reiji fights alongside Setsuna and Kunai. However, Reiji and the others are no match for his overwhelming strength. Then, Death Gavan deactivates his V-Suit. Tesshin Mikage reveals his true purpose to Reiji and invites him, saying, “Come with me, Infinity”…!?

As a massive battle erupts, Gavan and the others chase after Death Gavan and plunge into the Maque Space…!

videos.title: Patran's Decision
videos.overview:
A series of mysterious building bombings has occurred on MultiEarth A0073. Patran, who has successfully passed Gavan’s tests, is fired up to solve this case and earn himself a major achievement. When he rushes to the scene, he finds not only the First Investigative Division there, but also Reiji and Date from the Records Division for some reason...

Just then, a new bomb threat arrives from the culprit. With the deadline approaching and neither the culprit nor the bomb in sight, Patran makes “a certain decision”…!

videos.title: Runaway Space Express
videos.overview: Detecting a new wave of negative Emorgy, Reiji travels across dimensions to MultiEarth Φ5791. On Φ5791, where trains travel through outer space, humanity has been digitized, and the conductors are robots. Just then, an AI malfunction causes the space railroad to go into a runaway spree. Amid this crisis, Reiji transforms into Gavan Infinity and attempts to stop the runaway train by teaming up with the only Space Sheriff Gavan on MultiEarth Φ5791...!?

videos.title: For the Sake of Smiles
videos.overview:
Kiki and Kotobuki have finally arrested the elusive master thief Fade. Just as they begin questioning him in the interrogation room, they receive word that a massive meteorite is rapidly approaching Earth. Reiji also rushes across dimensions to MultiEarth I5109, but the meteorite is simply too massive for him to do anything about it...

In the midst of this critical situation, Kiki—who fights to bring smiles to everyone’s faces—notices something. As the deadline approaches, the “Greatest and Mightiest Guardian Deity” descends...!?

videos.title: Someone Special
videos.overview:
Setsuna and Rui find themselves conducting an undercover investigation at a bizarre matchmaking party on MultiEarth Λ8018. Reiji also rushes to the scene from another dimension, and the three of them, in disguise, begin making contact with the suspicious attendees. Just then, a mysterious queen wearing a mask appears, and the party venue turns into a “battlefield of love swirling with desire”…!?

Amidst all this, Setsuna’s “time-transcending feelings”—driven by his determination to protect what he holds dear—are revealed.

videos.title: Koto and Kiki
videos.overview: A hostage situation breaks out at the academy where Kiki and Kotobuki once attended. The two head to their alma mater, where they reunite with their former teacher, Miya Sakaura. Kiki attempts to negotiate with the hostage-taker but is shot and finds herself in a life-or-death situation! Faced with a critical decision, what will Kotobuki do…!? Meanwhile, Reiji attempts to cross dimensions and head to MultiEarth I5109, but finds himself trapped in the Maque Space...

videos.title: Because of Love
videos.overview: “The Truth of the Universe,” Aza Zorth, has a certain number of worshippers in each dimension, including Death Gavan. These prisoner-worshippers have been released into the world. Meanwhile, Reiji has finally crossed dimensions to arrive at MultiEarth I5109, where he learns of the events that befell Kiki and Kotobuki. Suddenly, he is swallowed up by the Maque Space and finds himself fighting Death Gavan and the escaped prisoners. As he desperately tries to rescue Kiki and the others as quickly as possible, Death Gavan makes him “a certain proposal”…

videos.title: Gavans Assemble
videos.overview: Finally, the forces of Aza Zorth have begun to move in earnest, and “Negapools” are erupting one after another on MultiEarth A0073. If this continues, the damage will spread throughout the galaxy, triggering the “Emorgy Syndrome”—a phenomenon where people’s anxiety invites even greater calamities.. Reiji steps up to try to stop the Emorgy Syndrome, but he finds himself cornered by rampaging soldiers, Emons, and the Maque Spaces that keep appearing one after another. Just as he feels he’s reached his limit fighting alone, the other Gavans gather from across dimensions. They’re about to perform a miracle that will change destiny…!

videos.title: Jo-Chaku
videos.overview:
A few days after the Death Gavan Fleet Invasion Incident, the escaped convicts resumed their evil activities across various dimensions. To stop them, Setsuna, Kiki, and Kunai each find themselves fighting their respective arch-enemies. However, with the Gavan System shut down, they are unable to transform into Gavan, leaving them in a dire predicament...

Meanwhile, Reiji, who was also in the midst of battle, was suddenly enveloped in a bright light and found himself face-to-face with the Supreme Chancellor in a mysterious space...

videos.title: Infinity
videos.overview: With the order to shut down the Gavan System lifted, Reiji, Setsuna, Kiki, and Kunai once again transform into Gavan. As each of them prepares to settle the score with their arch-enemies, Reiji—who has been entrusted with the emotions of the “higher dimension”—finally faces off against Death Gavan in a one-on-one battle. Soon, memories of his past with Gato resurface, and as Reiji fights across dimensions, the voices of his comrades reach him...

videos.title: Awaken! Red Kakuzyu King!
videos.overview:
Shout the Fiery, a treasure hunter well-versed in ancient scripts, spends his days deciphering ancient manuscripts, setting out on expeditions, and unearthing ancient artifacts. One day, while exploring an ancient ruin, Shout discovers the “Kakuzyu Awakener Omegahorn” and the “Egorgears” Though puzzled by the Omegahorn—which differs from the Kakuzyu Awakeners used by modern hunters—he tries setting the Egorgear into it, and a giant horned beast named Enkaku appears!

Enkaku recognizes the qualities of a “King” in Shout’s ego (his unwavering resolve to follow his own path) and, calling himself “Captain Omegahorn,” demands that Shout fight alongside him…!?
